issues.detail: Hebrew בִֽישִׁימ֣וֹן (biyshimon) means 'in the wilderness/desert' (בְּ + יְשִׁימוֹן), not '耶示崙' (Yeshurun). The Chinese renders it as a proper name '耶示崙' (Yeshurun), which is a different Hebrew word (יְשֻׁרוּן) and changes the meaning from 'in the wilderness' to a place/person name. This is a substantive mistranslation of the Hebrew text.
